scientific_integrity: An algebraic proof and exact small-field checker are supplied. Finite tests do not certify asymptotics; independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite field and growing dimension; the error is normalized absolute, not a relative estimate for growing corank. The known perfect case and 2LI natural-basis criterion are credited. Equivalent unindexed prior work is not excluded.
title: Asymptotic isomorphism enumeration and corank distribution of finite-field evolution algebras
